title: Search Mechanics
summary: improve the separate domain-owned search systems from one common Docs Viewer full-text and combined-corpus baseline
content_html:
Search Mechanics

Refine index inclusion, ranking, result context, and efficiency while retaining the current separate Catalogue and Docs Viewer static-search structure.

Feature Documents

  • DSI-1 — Docs Viewer Search Index v2 Delivery — complete and closed; every Docs Viewer scope uses one inverted-index structure and one browser query path.
  • DSI-2 — Scope-Level Sub-Scope Search Delivery — complete and closed; eligible documents from visibly hosted sub-scopes join one scope-level index with exact collection navigation and compact context.
  • SM-1 — Studio Full-Text Search Delivery — complete and closed; Studio searches authored headings, prose, and code while structural identity, update, and parent context remain non-searchable.
  • All-Scope Full-Text Search Baseline — complete and closed; every configured scope uses the same authored full-text fields, and Analysis has explicitly published the accepted Search-only delta.
  • SM-2 — Docs Viewer Search Relevance Delivery — proposed and unstarted; compare only bounded shared relevance signals against the completed all-scope baseline.
  • Studio Full-Text Search Index Concept — retained design and prototype record.
  • Docs Viewer Search Tokenizer Concept — retained term-semantics proposal and reasoning.
  • Search — current architecture and known weak spots.

Studio Documentation Maintenance rationalised the Studio corpus and added exact same-scope backlink visibility before search delivery. DSI-1, DSI-2, SM-1, and the all-scope full-text baseline are complete and closed. Their Roadmap concepts and deliveries remain here, while current contracts and durable proposals belong to Docs Viewer Search, Docs Viewer Search Index, Docs Viewer Search Tokenizer, and Docs Viewer Search Relevance outside the Roadmap hierarchy. Catalogue Search remains a separate later mechanics delivery.
